method: Longest contiguous wheel-parked segment; split when median adjacent-scan range change exceeds 0.02 m; abs(wheel speed) < 0.01 m/s. Apply car_measure.scan_statistics to that segment. Whole-run --lidar report mixes parked poses and is not a noise measurement.
noise_model_reason: 3 mm near; retain the 1.5 mm/m range slope of the same Hokuyo sensor measured 2026-10-30, consistent with 12 mm beyond 4 m here. No rear-right self returns in this stationary window.
